theme.title: Beyond the arc
theme.subtitle: The three-pointer, 1979 to today
theme.recap: It took the NBA years to use the three: the first record was eight in a game and the first 100-three season came in 1988.

questions.prompt: Away from the corners, how far is the NBA three-point arc from the center of the basket, in feet?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in the National Basketball Association (NBA) the arc is 23 feet 9 inches (7.24 m) from the center of the basket

questions.prompt: Rick Barry set the first NBA record for threes in a game in February 1980. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Barry would later set the original 3-point record at 8 in a single game on February 9, 1980 against the Utah Jazz.

questions.prompt: In 1987–88 Danny Ainge became the first player with 100 threes in a season. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Danny Ainge was the first player to make over 100 three-pointers in a season in 1988, scoring 148 that season.

questions.prompt: Reggie Miller retired in 2005 as the career leader in threes. How many had he made?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: eventually retiring with a record 2,560 three-pointers made.

questions.prompt: On December 1, 2016, how many three-point attempts did the Warriors and their opponent combine for?
questions.note: 88 three-point attempts between the two teams.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most combined three-point attempts in a single game: 88
